description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, Grinding Station and Weapons Manufacturing triggers.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter and Munitions tokens enter the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers twice and Sword of the Meek triggers from the Thopter entering.
Resolve both Grinding Station triggers, untapping it.
Resolve the Sword of the Meek trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Thopter.
Repeat from step 2.
